svg.title: DualMind — task deletion confirmation proposal
svg.desc: Illustrative confirmation for stopping and deleting one running task while preserving workspace files and other tasks. Variants show direct deletion, stopping, stop failure, and the empty-list new-task entry.
svg.text: STATIC SVG · Illustrative content · Base layout approved; additions pending review
